write_up: Your resume points clearly toward Staff Nurse, Medical ICU roles. A recruiter can see your patient load, the therapies you manage, and your charge and preceptor work. There are a couple of questions, but the clinical work is clear enough to move forward.

The direct care line is a good model: it names the patients, the shift assignment, and the unit. Your Arizona RN license and critical care certifications are easy to find, and the move from telemetry to the medical ICU is easy to follow.
